column2: Demand that this ruler abandon all of their colonial holdings, or answer for the refusal in single combat.

The Avatar [From.GetTitledFirstName] has come before me with a single demand: abandon every colony my realm holds, and let their peoples govern themselves. To refuse is to answer for it in single combat
Refuse, and meet them in combat

[decolonize_defiant.GetTitledFirstName] has refused my demand and chosen trial by combat instead. Their champions have withdrawn. This will be settled between the two of us, blade to element. If I win, the colonies fall. If I lose, or fall, the world will remember it.
